TextureGenerator.title: Texture Generator | FlectoneTools
TextureGenerator.description: Allows you to turn any image into a ready-made Minecraft texture by generating a JSON model. Simply upload your image, and the tool will automatically generate the texture as a JSON model file. Copy the finished result and place it into the images folder of the FlectonePulse plugin, after which the texture can be used immediately on your server. Full documentation and examples: https://flectone.net/pulse/docs/message/format/object

TextAnimation.title: Text Animation | FlectoneTools
TextAnimation.description: Creates animated texts with flicker, rainbow, wave, and letter-by-letter appearance effects. Adjust the speed and colors, and the tool will generate ready-to-use settings. Copy them into your plugin (e.g., FlectonePulse). Full documentation and examples: https://flectone.net/pulse/docs/message/format/animation

PrefixGenerator.title: Prefix Generator | FlectoneTools
PrefixGenerator.description: A visual editor for creating colored prefixes with gradients, symbols, and separators. The tool generates a ready-made prefix image that you can download and use anywhere, for example, in a Resource Pack, on social media, in videos, or for server branding

UuidExtractor.title: UUID Extractor | FlectoneTools
UuidExtractor.description: Finds a player's UUID by username. Supports offline and online modes. You can also generate a random UUID and copy the result

InventoryPreviewer.title: Inventory Viewer | FlectoneTools
InventoryPreviewer.description: Browse all Minecraft inventory slots — chests, furnaces, crafting tables and other containers

CoordinateCalculator.title: Coordinate Calculator | FlectoneTools
CoordinateCalculator.description: Convert coordinates between the Nether and the Overworld, and find the End stronghold using two ender eye throws

ColorTextGenerator.title: Color Text Generator | FlectoneTools
ColorTextGenerator.description: Create colored text for Minecraft with support for Legacy and MiniMessage formats

ServerFlagsGenerator.title: Server Flags Generator | FlectoneTools
ServerFlagsGenerator.description: Generate Minecraft server startup scripts with optimal JVM flags for Linux, Windows and Java.
